title: Consensus Layer — subsector_attributes
description: Fields specific to the Consensus Layer subsector. Covers Ethereum consensus clients (Beacon Node + Validator), the canonical Ethereum Consensus Specifications, and related consensus-layer infrastructure.

client_implementation.title: Client implementation
client_implementation.description: What kind of consensus implementation this is (e.g. 'Ethereum Consensus Client (Beacon Node + Validator Client)' for clients, 'N/A (Specification; not an executable client)' for specs).

role_in_consensus.title: Role in consensus
role_in_consensus.description: Semicolon-separated list of consensus duties this entity performs or defines (e.g. fork choice, validator duties, finality, slashing).

client_category.title: Client category
client_category.description: High-level category (e.g. 'Full Consensus Client (Beacon Node + Validator)', 'Canonical Consensus Specification').

client_scope.title: Client scope
client_scope.description: Scope of operation (e.g. 'Consensus-only (pairs with separate execution clients)', 'Governs all Ethereum consensus clients').

implementation_language.title: Implementation language
implementation_language.description: Primary language. Lowercase string like 'rust', 'go', 'java', 'typescript', 'nim', or 'n/a' for specs.

client_diversity_risk.title: Client diversity risk
client_diversity_risk.description: Risk this entity poses to Ethereum client diversity. 'high' means concentration risk if this client dominates; 'medium' / 'low' lower. 'n/a' for specs.

client_diversity_risk_note.title: Client diversity risk note
client_diversity_risk_note.description: Editorial note on the diversity contribution (e.g. 'Positive for Client Diversity', 'Intended' for the canonical spec).
